first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A youth-like person wearing a brown furry hat and dark-framed glasses, dressed in a khaki uniform and shorts, and carrying a large backpack.

entities.name: camping backpack
entities.identification: The tall orange-brown backpack behind Person A, with yellow fabric protruding from the top and two light brown rolls arranged vertically and a long silver-gray pole attached to the outside.

entities.name: small bouquet of white flowers
entities.identification: The small bouquet held in front of Person A, composed of small white flowers and green leaves and branches.

entities.name: golden-yellow grassland
entities.identification: A large expanse of tall golden-yellow grass covering the foreground and middle ground, with a flattened grassy path and upright dark green weeds nearby.

entities.name: distant band of dark green trees
entities.identification: A band of dark green trees and shrubs stretching across the distant view behind the grassland, with a continuously undulating treetop outline.

entities.name: distant wind turbine with slender blades
entities.identification: The wind turbine in the distant view on the image-left side, with a circular radial rotor and part of its slender support visible.

entities.name: light-colored sky
entities.identification: The warm, pale yellow sky above the band of trees, with faint cloud-like textures.
